tag_picker.title: Insert Tag
tag.hint.html.paragraph: wraps paragraph text. No required attributes.
tag.hint.html.heading1: <h1> creates the top-level page heading. Common parameters: id, class.
tag.hint.html.heading2: <h2> creates a level 2 heading. Common parameters: id, class.
tag.hint.html.heading3: <h3> creates a level 3 heading. Common parameters: id, class.
tag.hint.html.heading4: <h4> creates a level 4 subheading. Common parameters: id, class.
tag.hint.html.strong: <strong> marks important text. No common required attributes.
tag.hint.html.emphasis: <em> marks contextual emphasis. No common required attributes.
tag.hint.html.link: <a> creates a link. Main parameter: href URL.
tag.hint.html.link_blank: <a> opens in a new tab. Parameters: href URL, target, rel.
tag.hint.html.image: inserts an image. Main parameters: src image path, alt text.
tag.hint.html.figure: <figure> groups media and caption. Parameters: img src, img alt, figcaption text.
tag.hint.html.div: <div> creates a generic block. Common parameters: class, id, data-*.
tag.hint.html.span: <span> marks inline text. Common parameters: class, id, data-*.
tag.hint.html.blockquote: <blockquote> marks quoted content. Common parameters: cite, class.
tag.hint.html.unordered_list: <ul> creates a bullet list. Common parameters: class, id.
tag.hint.html.ordered_list: <ol> creates a numbered list. Common parameters: start, reversed, type.
tag.hint.html.code: <code> marks inline code. Common parameters: class.
tag.hint.html.pre_code: <pre><code> preserves whitespace for code. Common parameters: class on code for language.
tag.hint.html.line_break:
inserts a forced line break. Use

for normal paragraph breaks.
tag.hint.html.horizontal_rule: <hr> represents a thematic break. Common parameters: class.
tag.hint.markdown.heading1: Inserts a level 1 heading. Usually use only one per page.
tag.hint.markdown.bold: Wraps text with Markdown bold markers.
tag.hint.markdown.italic: Wraps text with Markdown italic markers.
tag.hint.markdown.strikethrough: Wraps text with Markdown strikethrough markers.
tag.hint.markdown.link: Creates a Markdown link. Parameter: destination URL.
tag.hint.markdown.image: Creates a Markdown image. Parameters: alt text and image URL/path.
tag.hint.markdown.code_block: Creates a fenced code block. Put the language name after the opening fence.
tag.hint.markdown.code_block_python: Creates a fenced Python code block.
tag.hint.markdown.code_block_html: Creates a fenced HTML code block.
tag.hint.markdown.code_block_css: Creates a fenced CSS code block.
tag.hint.markdown.code_block_javascript: Creates a fenced JavaScript code block.
tag.hint.markdown.code_block_json: Creates a fenced JSON code block.
tag.hint.markdown.code_block_powershell: Creates a fenced PowerShell code block.
tag.hint.markdown.code_block_bash: Creates a fenced Bash code block.
tag.hint.markdown.code_block_sql: Creates a fenced SQL code block.
tag.hint.markdown.task_unchecked: Creates an unchecked task list item. The [ ] marks the checkbox state.
tag.hint.markdown.task_checked: Creates a checked task list item. The [x] marks the checkbox state.
tag.hint.markdown.table_2x2: Inserts a 2-column Markdown table. The first row is headers; the --- row separates headers from data.
tag.hint.wordpress.paragraph_block: Inserts a WordPress paragraph block wrapper.
tag.hint.wordpress.heading2_block: Inserts a WordPress heading block with h2.
tag.hint.wordpress.heading3_block: Inserts a WordPress heading block with level 3 attributes and h3.
tag.hint.wordpress.list_block: Inserts a WordPress list block with one list item.
tag.hint.wordpress.code_block: Inserts a WordPress core/code block using pre.wp-block-code and code.
tag.hint.wordpress.preformatted_block: Inserts a WordPress preformatted block for spacing-preserved text.
tag.hint.wordpress.html_code_box: Inserts a core/html block containing the styled pre/code box.
tag.hint.wordpress.buttons_block: Inserts a WordPress buttons block with one button link.
tag.hint.wordpress.link_block: Inserts a normal link inside a WordPress paragraph block. Put the destination URL in href.
tag.hint.wordpress.custom_frame_block: Inserts a WordPress group frame whose border width, border color, background color, and text color can be edited in style. Adjust border, background-color, and color.
tag.hint.wordpress.notice_frame_block: Inserts a yellow notice frame. Edit border, background-color, and color in style to adjust border width, border color, background, and text.
tag.hint.wordpress.info_frame_block: Inserts a blue information frame for notes or reference text.
tag.hint.wordpress.important_frame_block: Inserts a red important frame for text that should draw stronger attention. The default border is slightly thicker.
tag.hint.wordpress.image_block: Inserts a WordPress image block. The src position is selected, and selected text is used as alt text.
tag.hint.wordpress.media_text_left_block: Inserts a WordPress media and text block with image on the left and heading/text on the right.
tag.hint.wordpress.media_text_right_bloc: Inserts a WordPress media and text block with heading/text on the left and image on the right.
tag.hint.wordpress.gallery_3_block: Inserts a WordPress gallery block with three images.
tag.hint.wordpress.columns_3_images_bloc: Inserts a WordPress columns block with one image in each of three columns.
tag.hint.wordpress.columns_2_text_block: Inserts a WordPress columns block that splits text into two columns. Selected text goes into the first column.
tag.hint.wordpress.columns_3_text_block: Inserts a WordPress columns block that splits text into three columns. Selected text goes into the first column.
tag.hint.wordpress.image_row_html_block: Inserts a custom HTML block that lays out three images in one row.
tag.hint.wordpress.float_left_image_bloc: Inserts a custom HTML block with a left-floated image and flowing text.
tag.hint.wordpress.float_right_image_blo: Inserts a custom HTML block with a right-floated image and flowing text.
tag.hint.wordpress.video_block: Inserts a WordPress video block. The src position is selected, and selected text is used as the caption.
tag.hint.wordpress.audio_block: Inserts a WordPress audio block. The src position is selected, and selected text is used as the caption.

regex_lint.empty_match: This pattern can match empty text. Empty matches are skipped.
regex_lint.broad: This pattern can match very broad ranges of text.
regex_lint.leading_dot_star: A leading .* can make searches slower and less precise.
regex_lint.unescaped_dot: A dot matches any one character. Use \. when you need a literal dot.
regex_lint.backslash_n: \n means a line break in regex. Use it only when you want to match an actual newline.
regex_lint.trailing_escape: The pattern ends with a backslash. Escape the backslash as \\ if you need a literal backslash.
regex_lint.backref_without_group: The replacement uses a group reference, but the pattern has no capture group.
